desc: UTG complete AR-15 cleaning kit will easily stored in the A-2 buttstock or the included two compartment lightweight nylon bag. The kit is comprised of five piece rods (includes loop), adaptor, bronze bore brush, chamber brush, dual-ended nylon brush, oil bottle and cleaning cloth. Pouch includes belt loop and Alice clip for attachment to belt or web gear. Standard 8-32 threads for any compatible components on the market.
